name: Chicken Stew (Cacciatore) with Pepper, Zucchini & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
1 medium zucchini squash
½ medium head cauliflower
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper; trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic; set aside.
Cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle with cornstarch and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.45 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes. (The chicken will not be cooked all the way through.)
Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, zucchini, and spices to the pan with the chicken; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp rosemary, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop olives.

When the veggies are done, add olives, tomatoes, and broth to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until stew has thickened and chicken is cooked through, 6-8 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (398 ml) can diced tomatoes
118 ml (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the stew is simmering, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and salt; cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the stew is done, add half of the basil to the pan; stir to combine and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and chicken stew between bowls; top with reserved basil and enjoy!
